post.text: 🚨: Psilocybin extends life of human cells by 50% in wild new study. https://t.co/Fhj6X3VRcS
post.author_description: 🌌 Daily updates on space, astronomy & cosmic discoveries 🚀 | Science breakthroughs & the wonders of the universe

description.description: A close-up photograph shows a cluster of Psilocybe azurescens mushrooms growing out of a decaying, moss-covered log. The mushrooms have smooth, caramel-colored caps and slender, pale-bluish stems. The forest background is softly blurred.

A digital illustration of three mushrooms with conical caps, rendered in a colorful, psychedelic style. The mushrooms are colored with a heat-map effect featuring vibrant blues, yellows, oranges, and greens. They are set against a soft, out-of-focus background of multi-colored bokeh circles in shades of green, purple, and orange.
